parameters.name: application
parameters.description: The application that submitted as a job, either jar or py file. (templated)

parameters.name: conf
parameters.description: Arbitrary Spark configuration properties (templated)

parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: The :ref:`spark connection id <howto/connection:spark-submit>` as configured in Airflow administration. When an invalid connection_id is supplied, it will default to yarn.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Upload additional files to the executor running the job, separated by a comma. Files will be placed in the working directory of each executor. For example, serialized objects. (templated)

parameters.name: py_files
parameters.description: Additional python files used by the job, can be .zip, .egg or .py. (templated)

parameters.name: driver_class_path
parameters.description: Additional, driver-specific, classpath settings. (templated)

parameters.name: jars
parameters.description: Submit additional jars to upload and place them in driver and executor classpaths. (templated)

parameters.name: java_class
parameters.description: the main class of the Java application

parameters.name: packages
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of maven coordinates of jars to include on the driver and executor classpaths. (templated)

parameters.name: exclude_packages
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of maven coordinates of jars to exclude while resolving the dependencies provided in 'packages' (templated)

parameters.name: repositories
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of additional remote repositories to search for the maven coordinates given with 'packages'

parameters.name: total_executor_cores
parameters.description: (Standalone & Mesos only) Total cores for all executors (Default: all the available cores on the worker)

parameters.name: executor_cores
parameters.description: (Standalone & YARN only) Number of cores per executor (Default: 2)

parameters.name: executor_memory
parameters.description: Memory per executor (e.g. 1000M, 2G) (Default: 1G)

parameters.name: driver_memory
parameters.description: Memory allocated to the driver (e.g. 1000M, 2G) (Default: 1G)

parameters.name: keytab
parameters.description: Full path to the file that contains the keytab (templated) (will overwrite any keytab defined in the connection's extra JSON)

parameters.name: principal
parameters.description: The name of the kerberos principal used for keytab (templated) (will overwrite any principal defined in the connection's extra JSON)

parameters.name: proxy_user
parameters.description: User to impersonate when submitting the application (templated)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the job (default airflow-spark). (templated)

parameters.name: num_executors
parameters.description: Number of executors to launch

parameters.name: status_poll_interval
parameters.description: Seconds to wait between polls of driver status in cluster mode (Default: 1)

parameters.name: application_args
parameters.description: Arguments for the application being submitted (templated)

parameters.name: env_vars
parameters.description: Environment variables for spark-submit. It supports yarn and k8s mode too. (templated)

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Whether to pass the verbose flag to spark-submit process for debugging

parameters.name: spark_binary
parameters.description: The command to use for spark submit. Some distros may use spark2-submit or spark3-submit. (will overwrite any spark_binary defined in the connection's extra JSON)

parameters.name: properties_file
parameters.description: Path to a file from which to load extra properties. If not specified, this will look for conf/spark-defaults.conf.

parameters.name: yarn_queue
parameters.description: The name of the YARN queue to which the application is submitted. (will overwrite any yarn queue defined in the connection's extra JSON)

parameters.name: deploy_mode
parameters.description: Whether to deploy your driver on the worker nodes (cluster) or locally as a client. (will overwrite any deployment mode defined in the connection's extra JSON)

parameters.name: use_krb5ccache
parameters.description: if True, configure spark to use ticket cache instead of relying on keytab for Kerberos login

parameters.name: spark_app_name
parameters.description: Name of the job (default airflow-spark-jdbc)

parameters.name: spark_conn_id
parameters.description: The :ref:`spark connection id <howto/connection:spark-submit>` as configured in Airflow administration

parameters.name: spark_conf
parameters.description: Any additional Spark configuration properties

parameters.name: spark_py_files
parameters.description: Additional python files used (.zip, .egg, or .py)

parameters.name: spark_files
parameters.description: Additional files to upload to the container running the job

parameters.name: spark_jars
parameters.description: Additional jars to upload and add to the driver and executor classpath

parameters.name: cmd_type
parameters.description: Which way the data should flow. 2 possible values: spark_to_jdbc: data written by spark from metastore to jdbc jdbc_to_spark: data written by spark from jdbc to metastore

parameters.name: jdbc_table
parameters.description: The name of the JDBC table

parameters.name: jdbc_conn_id
parameters.description: Connection id used for connection to JDBC database

parameters.name: jdbc_driver
parameters.description: Name of the JDBC driver to use for the JDBC connection. This driver (usually a jar) should be passed in the 'jars' parameter

parameters.name: metastore_table
parameters.description: The name of the metastore table,

parameters.name: jdbc_truncate
parameters.description: (spark_to_jdbc only) Whether Spark should truncate or drop and recreate the JDBC table. This only takes effect if 'save_mode' is set to Overwrite. Also, if the schema is different, Spark cannot truncate, and will drop and recreate

parameters.name: save_mode
parameters.description: The Spark save-mode to use (e.g. overwrite, append, etc.)

parameters.name: save_format
parameters.description: (jdbc_to_spark-only) The Spark save-format to use (e.g. parquet)

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: (spark_to_jdbc only) The size of the batch to insert per round trip to the JDBC database. Defaults to 1000

parameters.name: fetch_size
parameters.description: (jdbc_to_spark only) The size of the batch to fetch per round trip from the JDBC database. Default depends on the JDBC driver

parameters.name: num_partitions
parameters.description: The maximum number of partitions that can be used by Spark simultaneously, both for spark_to_jdbc and jdbc_to_spark operations. This will also cap the number of JDBC connections that can be opened

parameters.name: partition_column
parameters.description: (jdbc_to_spark-only) A numeric column to be used to partition the metastore table by. If specified, you must also specify: num_partitions, lower_bound, upper_bound

parameters.name: lower_bound
parameters.description: (jdbc_to_spark-only) Lower bound of the range of the numeric partition column to fetch. If specified, you must also specify: num_partitions, partition_column, upper_bound

parameters.name: upper_bound
parameters.description: (jdbc_to_spark-only) Upper bound of the range of the numeric partition column to fetch. If specified, you must also specify: num_partitions, partition_column, lower_bound

parameters.name: create_table_column_types
parameters.description: (spark_to_jdbc-only) The database column data types to use instead of the defaults, when creating the table. Data type information should be specified in the same format as CREATE TABLE columns syntax (e.g: "name CHAR(64), comments VARCHAR(1024)"). The specified types should be valid spark sql data types.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: The SQL query to execute. (templated)
